北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微凉，记得带伞，早晚添衣哦。
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is overcast and slightly cool. Remember your umbrella and dress warmly in mornings/evenings.

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 有雾驾车慢行，湿度大体感闷，注意防潮哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: It's foggy in Cixi, drive slowly. High humidity makes it feel stuffy, stay dry.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 多云体感微热，湿度不低，注意补水保持心情舒畅。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy, feels a bit warm and humid. Stay hydrated and keep a happy mood.
上海.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨湿热，带伞防暑，注意防滑。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, hot and humid. Bring an umbrella, prevent heatstroke, watch for slips.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天闷热，湿度高，多喝水，注意防暑。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast and stuffy. High humidity. Drink water, prevent heatstroke.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天微热，体感尚可，出门带伞，以防有雨。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is overcast and slightly warm. Bring an umbrella just in case.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，气温适宜，适合户外活动，享受阳光吧！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is sunny and pleasant. Perfect for outdoors, enjoy the sunshine!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天炎热，体感温度高，注意防暑补水哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is overcast and hot. High perceived temp. Prevent heatstroke, drink water.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 多云微热，及时补水，保持活力，享受一天。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and a bit warm. Stay hydrated and energetic.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天湿度大，体感略闷，注意防潮和通风。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is overcast and humid, feels a bit stuffy. Keep dry and ensure ventilation.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 多云炎热，气温高，注意防暑，多喝水哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and very hot. Prevent heatstroke, drink plenty of water.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗舒适，阳光明媚，适合外出游玩，心情棒棒。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and comfortable. Perfect for outdoors, enjoy the day!
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 晴朗无风，气温舒适，适合户外散步，享受惬意。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and calm, comfortable temps. Perfect for an outdoor stroll.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 多云风大，体感微凉，出门注意防风保暖哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and windy, feels cool. Mind the wind and dress warmly.
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 小雨湿热，湿度高，出门带伞，注意防潮。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen has light rain, warm and humid. High humidity. Bring an umbrella, mind the dampness.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 多云舒适，湿度略高，记得通风，保持好心情。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and comfortable. High humidity, ensure ventilation, keep a good mood.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 阴天体感较凉，湿度不低，出门添衣注意保暖。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is overcast and cool. High humidity. Add clothes and stay warm.
